NAME: Aggregate
DESCRIPTION: The process of summarizing or combining data points in a time series, often using statistical measures such as mean, max, min, etc.

NAME: Calculate
DESCRIPTION: The process of performing mathematical operations on data points in a time series to derive new values or metrics.

NAME: Correction
DESCRIPTION: The process of adjusting data points in a time series to account for known biases, errors, or other factors that may affect the accuracy of the data.

NAME: Quality Control
DESCRIPTION: The process of identifying and removing erroneous or suspect data points in a time series based on predefined criteria or rules.

NAME: Infill
DESCRIPTION: The process of filling in missing data points in a time series, often using interpolation or other estimation techniques.
